subject: City Charter Review Schedule
overview: The Governance Committee established a timeline and procedural guidelines for reviewing the proposed City Charter updates across three upcoming winter meetings with the Collins Center. The committee approved a package of motions setting submission deadlines for amendments, requesting School Committee feedback, and asking for public notice and comparative charter analysis.

items.title: Resolution 24-468: Updates to the City Charter
items.summary: The committee approved a slate of procedural motions setting submission deadlines for council amendments, requesting feedback from the School Committee and municipal boards by February 12, seeking a comparative memorandum from the Collins Center, and requesting citywide public notice of upcoming charter meetings. The committee also scheduled three themed working sessions through February to review charter articles covering the legislative branch, executive administration, elections, and school governance.
